Subject: Webinar follow-up & quick demo? — Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for joining our "Cost & Latency at Scale" webinar last week — really glad you could make it. A few attendees mentioned they wanted a short, personalized demo to see how Redwood could reduce per-token cost and keep latency predictable for production traffic.

If that sounds useful, I can set up a 30-minute walkthrough tailored to your streaming transaction use case. Here are a couple of things we can cover quickly:
- Live demo of model routing and autoscale behavior for peak volume
- Cost/latency dashboard and per-route breakdowns
- SSO & audit log requirements for procurement

I have availability this week and next. You can pick a time that works here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30min

Attaching our one-pager/demo deck for context (redwood-demo-deck.pdf).

Would love to get something on the calendar — happy to loop in Marcus (AE) if you'd like the commercial side present.

Best,
